title: Sunan da aka Ba wa Kafin Haihuwa
intro: Ka yi tunanin wani wuri mai natsuwa cike da addu'o'i na gaske bayan shekaru da yawa na jira. Daga gaibi akwai amsar da ke ɗauke da suna da ba a taɓa bayarwa ba, tana alƙawarin hikima tun daga ƙuruciya da kuma rayuwa mai cike da ibada, tausayi, da tsarki.
clues: Allah da kansa ne ya sanya min suna kafin a haife ni, wanda ba a taɓa sanya wa kowa suna ba kafin ni.
Iyaye tsofaffi sun ba ni amsa ga addu'o'in da na yi da gaske, waɗanda suka yi tunanin cewa zuriya ba za ta yiwu ba.
An ba ni hikima, shari'a, da kuma Littafi Mai Tsarki tun ina ƙarami.
Na kasance mai biyayya ga iyayena kuma ina tausaya wa wasu, kuma ban kasance mai girman kai ko rashin biyayya ba.
Allah ya wajabta min aminci a ranar da aka haife ni, ranar da na mutu, da ranar da za a tashe ni ina raye.
Mahaifina Zakariyya ya sami bushara daga mala'iku yayin da yake tsaye yana addu'a a cikin harami (mihrab).

trial.label: Albarka da Gwaji
options: Wani babban kifi ya haɗiye shi saboda ya tafi cikin fushi
An jefa shi cikin wuta mai zafi domin ya lalata gumaka
An hana shi mafaka kuma aka bar shi don ya rene shi ta hanyar kerkeci
An ba wa iyaye tsofaffi bayan addu'a mai ƙarfi
Ya fuskanci Fir'auna ya kuma jagoranci tafiyar da suka yi a ketaren teku
trial.answer: An ba wa iyaye tsofaffi bayan addu'a mai ƙarfi

location.label: Maɓallin Wuri
options: Wurin ibada (mihrab) inda aka yi shelar bishara
Wutar da masu bautar gumaka suka shirya
Cikin babban kifi a cikin zurfin teku
Kogon da masu barci suka huta tsawon ƙarni da yawa
Kwarin tururuwa a kan wani gangamin sarauta
location.answer: Wurin ibada (mihrab) inda aka yi shelar bishara

outcome.label: Daraja ta Allah
options: An jifa duwatsu daga sama da yumbun da aka gasa
An haɗiye shi da rai da ƙasa saboda girman kai a kan taska
An yi masa tsawa saboda ya yi wa rakumin rauni
An nutsar da shi cikin wani mai girman kai a cikin teku da aka raba
Aminci ya tabbata a gare ni ranar da aka haife ni, ranar da na mutu, da ranar da aka tashe ni da rai
outcome.answer: Aminci ya tabbata a gare ni ranar da aka haife ni, ranar da na mutu, da ranar da aka tashe ni da rai

arabic: قَالَ رَبِّ أَنَّىٰ يَكُونُ لِى غُلَـٰمٌۭ وَقَدْ بَلَغَنِىَ ٱلْكِبَرُ وَٱمْرَأَتِى عَاقِرٌۭ ۖ قَالَ كَذَٰلِكَ ٱللَّهُ يَفْعَلُ مَا يَشَآءُ
verse: He said, "My Lord, how will I have a boy when I have reached old age and my wife is barren?" He [the angel] said, "Such is Allāh; He does what He wills." (3:40)
